sources.entry: Leantime - Lean project management system for small teams and startups helping to manage projects from ideation through delivery. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 PHP/Docker

summary.one_liner: Leantime is an open-source, self-hostable project management system aimed at non-project managers, covering tasks, planning, knowledge management and administration for small teams.
summary.what_it_does: Provides task management with kanban, Gantt, table, list and calendar views, plus unlimited subtasks, dependencies, milestones and sprint management. Covers project planning with dashboards, reports, status updates, goal and metrics tracking, and canvases such as Lean/Business Model, SWOT and risk analysis. Includes knowledge tools: wikis/docs, idea boards, retrospectives, file storage via S3 or local filesystem, and comments on items. Offers timetracking and timesheets, multiple user roles with per-project permissions, two-factor authentication, LDAP and OIDC integration, and a plugin system and JSON-RPC API. Installs locally on PHP/MySQL/MariaDB or via an official Docker image with a docker-compose file.
use_cases: manage projects from ideation through delivery
track tasks on kanban boards and Gantt charts
run sprints and milestones for a small team
keep team wiki, docs and retrospectives
self-host a Trello or Jira alternative
how_to_run: docker run -d --restart unless-stopped -p 8080:8080 --network leantime-net -e LEAN_DB_HOST=mysql_leantime -e LEAN_DB_USER=admin -e LEAN_DB_PASSWORD=... -e LEAN_DB_DATABASE=leantime -e LEAN_EMAIL_RETURN=... --name leantime leantime/leantime:latest
Go to /install in the browser and complete the installation script (Docker)
Local install: download the release zip, create an empty MySQL database, point the domain root to public/
Rename config/sample.env to config/.env and fill in database credentials, then navigate to /install
Development: run make clean build, then make run-dev (dev server on port 5080)
stack: Apache or Nginx (IIS supported with changes)
notable: Designed with ADHD, dyslexia and autism in mind, per the README
All listed features included in the open-source version
Official Docker image and docker-compose setup
Extensible through plugins, a JSON-RPC API, and an included Slack, Mattermost and Discord integration list
Plugin folder can be mounted in Docker so plugins survive restarts
caveats: Support is limited to the official Docker compose and standard installations; Cloudron, Elestio, Turnkey and other distributions are not supported
Support covers only the most recent version
Some extras such as the plugin marketplace, managed hosting and installation services are paid offerings
